findings.summary: build_features standardizes using mean/std of the whole DataFrame before train_test_split, leaking test data into training and making test AUC optimistic.
Training mean/std are not saved, so serving on new data computes its own statistics and features won't match what the model was trained on.
Zero or NaN std (constant column or single-row frame) is not handled, producing NaN/inf features that make LogisticRegression.fit raise a ValueError.
